items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And did you know Lonnie Jackson, a piano player? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I didn't.

ctx.x: I don't remember, there was a client that played, I haven't been able to call his name yet, that went to Europe. He was a member that day.
And did you know Lonnie Jackson, a piano player?
